nodes.label: Core Library README
nodes.rationale: Documents the shared core library that runs identically on server and client (wasm32), ensuring parity by construction. Covers document parsing, YAML subset, dates, filter DSL, and splices.

nodes.label: Shared Core (ddd-core)
nodes.rationale: The shared parsing/filter crate that compiles to both native (server) and wasm32 (client kernel), ensuring identical behavior. Covers document parsing, YAML subset, dates, filter DSL, and splices.

nodes.label: Filter DSL
nodes.rationale: Custom filter language (not Mongo's) with same-type comparisons, explicit contains/any, missing vs null distinction, and explicit date type. Evaluated identically on client and server.

nodes.label: Splice Helpers
nodes.rationale: Line-based edit computation for frontmatter and machine sections, never parsing and re-serializing blocks. Preserves comments and formatting, supports concurrent edits.
